title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 4801 West Van Giesen Street in West Richland, Washington, as the "Sergeant Dietrich Schmieman Post Office Building".
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 4801 West Van Giesen Street in West Richland, Washington, as the "Sergeant Dietrich Schmieman Post Office Building."

summary.headline: Names a post office building in West Richland, Washington, after Sergeant Dietrich Schmieman.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames a United States Postal Service facility at 4801 West Van Giesen Street in West Richland, Washington. The building will be officially called the Sergeant Dietrich Schmieman Post Office Building. It does not change how the post office operates or what services it provides.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was signed on December 6, 2018.
